director_findings: The independent review is consistent with the merged B11 source-first plan, current Chapter 6 source and the 295-question canonical baseline.

C004 is rejected because its answer-defining proposition converts source examples of probability and consequence mitigation into a stronger mandatory dual-consideration duty that is not explicit enough to accept under fail-closed source support.

C010 is rejected because Q266 already tests stationary-front persistence and explicitly identifies Baiu/Autumn-rain fronts as examples; the proposed subtype framing adds insufficient solving-rule distinctness for the 400-target quality floor.

The five accepted Tier B candidates C014, C017, C018, C019 and C020 retain material source-defined distinctions in temporal start-gate, GNSS failure, battery failure, explicit exception boundary and forced-landing lifecycle state.
No accepted B11 candidate relies on a subsection explicitly marked 〔一等〕.
The 20-candidate ceiling is not a quota. Two candidates are deliberately dropped without backfill.
No HUMAN review is claimed or fabricated.
